parameters.name: Categories
parameters.description: A list of template categories. Valid values: `Other`, `TimerTrigger`, `EventTrigger`, and `AlarmTrigger`. You can specify either this parameter or `Category`, but not both. We recommend that you use `Categories`.

parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The category of the template. Valid values: `Other`, `TimerTrigger`, `EventTrigger`, and `AlarmTrigger`.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: The level of execution data to return. Valid values: `RootDepth` and `FirstChildDepth`. `RootDepth` returns only parent executions. `FirstChildDepth` returns only first-level child executions. You can specify either this parameter or `IncludeChildExecution`, but not both. We recommend that you use `Depth`.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the execution.

parameters.name: EndDateAfter
parameters.description: Specifies a filter to return only executions that ended at or after this time.

parameters.name: EndDateBefore
parameters.description: Specifies a filter to return only executions that ended at or before this time.

parameters.name: ExecutedBy
parameters.description: The user who started the execution.

parameters.name: ExecutionId
parameters.description: The ID of the execution.

parameters.name: IncludeChildExecution
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include child executions in the results. The default is False.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 100. The default is 50.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description:
The execution mode. Valid values:

- **Automatic**

- **Debug**

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token returned from a previous call that you can use to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: ParentExecutionId
parameters.description: The ID of the parent execution.

parameters.name: RamRole
parameters.description: The RAM role.

parameters.name: RdFolderIds
parameters.description: The IDs of folders in Resource Directory. Use this parameter to query executions within specific folders.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS resource.

parameters.name: ResourceTemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the resource's template.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description:
The field to use for sorting the returned executions. Valid values:

- **StartDate** (default): the time when the execution was created

- **EndDate**: the end time of the execution

- **Status**: the status of the execution

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: ascending order

- **Descending** (default): descending order

parameters.name: StartDateAfter
parameters.description: Specifies a filter to return only executions that started at or after this time.

parameters.name: StartDateBefore
parameters.description: Specifies a filter to return only executions that started at or before this time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of the execution. Valid values: `Running`, `Started`, `Success`, `Failed`, `Waiting`, `Cancelled`, `Pending`, and `Skipped`.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags attached to the execution.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The name of the template. This parameter supports fuzzy search. The operation returns executions of templates whose names contain the value you specify.
